baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active and passive forms of ع ق ب surround بِمِثْلِ, before a distinct passive ب غ ي and the emphatic promise of ن ص ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first injury licenses a consequent response only up to likeness; ثم marks a new excess after that bounded response, and divine aid attaches to the responder who is made a patient again.

activation_trace.role: Punishment after an offense supplies the literal retaliatory act and makes it consequent rather than initiating.
Equivalence between two things supplies the visible ceiling that calibrates the response.
Transgressing the limit supplies the second, disqualifying excess after parity has been observed.
Vindication of the wronged supplies the promised intervention for the re-victimized bounded responder.
Leaving deserved punishment supplies a closing restraint that prevents the promise from licensing unlimited revenge.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply permits revenge and promises victory.
changed_reading.after: It authorizes only a visibly equivalent consequent response; when a distinct later excess re-victimizes that responder, divine aid is promised as vindication.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ع ق ب root appears twice across a role reversal, followed by ثم and the paired names عفو and غفور.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root's succession, recurrence, and residue images expose retaliation as a potentially self-renewing chain. The second aggression proves that equivalence did not close it; aid can close the chain by erasing and covering its remainder rather than adding another round.

activation_trace.role: One thing succeeding another supplies the serial structure of injury, response, and renewed injury.
Return to an act after a like act supplies the danger of recursive retaliation.
A remainder or lingering trace supplies the aftermath through which conflict can restart.
Erasure of an old trace supplies a subtractive way to terminate the sequence.
A covering that protects what it encloses supplies containment of whatever residue remains.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports one justified reprisal followed by divine help.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a sequence that can recur through its residue and promises aid capable of terminating aftermath, not merely winning another round.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The promise لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ is immediately qualified by the operationally different names عفو and غفور.
baseline_models.mechanism: Support need not be additive counterforce. عفو can remove punishment or erase its track, while غفر covers and protects; together they keep restorative release and protective shielding alongside literal vindication.

activation_trace.role: Aid and making one prevail supply the ordinary forceful reading that this model revises without deleting.
Forgoing punishment supplies release from further penal action.
Erasing a trace supplies repair by subtraction rather than retaliation by addition.
Covering and preserving supply a protective form of support.
Shielding a person from an offense's consequence supplies restoration after the conflict.

changed_reading.before: Divine support means adding superior force to the victim's force.
changed_reading.after: Divine support may coexist as vindication, release, erasure, and shielding, so the promised outcome need not mimic the aggressor's action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places divine support in worldly and otherworldly horizons, later inserts long respite before reckoning, and immediately before the focus promises provision and entry to people killed or dead. The focus promise therefore survives bodily defeat and can mature as provision, admission, or eventual vindication.

activation_trace.role: Aid and prevailing supply the promise whose temporal range is being reopened.
The earlier support occurrence spans world and afterlife in its source clause, supplying multiple horizons for the same aid image.
Extended time and respite supply delay before the following seizure.
The split root's second time-extension inventory independently preserves the long-delay image.
Loss of life supplies an explicit case in which the promised beneficiary does not receive simple battlefield survival.
Departure of life broadens the preceding case beyond violent death.
An apportioned gift supplies the guaranteed outcome for both the killed and those who die.
Entry into an interior supplies a promised destination immediately before the focus verse.

structural_cues: 22:58-60 is contiguous and repeats emphatic future promises of provision, entry, and support.
The focus opens with ذَٰلِكَ after people explicitly described as killed or dead.
22:44-48 repeatedly places seizure after extended respite and denies that divine promise fails.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent future guarantees across death and a prior pattern of delayed reckoning; I infer that the focus promise shares that non-immediate temporal range. Immediate worldly rescue remains a live alternative, not an excluded reading.

changed_reading.before: Support must mean immediate survival or tactical victory after the second aggression.
changed_reading.after: Support is a guaranteed outcome across more than one horizon and can take the form of provision or welcome even when the bounded responder is killed or dies.

context_deltas.mechanism: Equality at the sanctuary, people checking other people, and a publicly announced example turn مِثْل from private felt symmetry into a legible common measure. Its neighboring branch of exemplary punishment also marks the failure mode: measured redress can become punitive display.

activation_trace.role: Similarity and equalization supply the focus response's explicit measure.
Punishment that makes a person an example supplies the danger of turning proportion into spectacle.
Equality between two parties supplies a public parity independent of resident or visitor status.
A just middle and equitable place supplies the normative center for measuring the response.
Removing harm supplies the function of reciprocal social checking.
Parts of a whole supply the image of groups checking one another within a shared order.
An example as lesson supplies public intelligibility rather than private equivalence alone.
Rendering and displaying an example supplies the public test by which a claimed likeness can be seen.

structural_cues: 22:25 declares equal access for resident and visitor before naming injustice.
22:40 repeats بعضهم ببعض, making reciprocal force relational rather than private.
22:73 addresses all people and commands attention to a displayed مثل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public equality, reciprocal social checking, and a displayed example; I infer that the focus likeness should be publicly recognizable and status-neutral. A narrower quantitative match remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The injured party alone decides what counts as a matching response.
changed_reading.after: The likeness functions as a common, equitable standard that checks both sides and must not turn the punished person into a deterrent spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier conflict sequence moves from divine defense, to permission because people are passively fought and wronged, to reciprocal دفع that prevents demolition of several kinds of worship site. This gives bounded retaliation a protective object beyond the responder's honor.

activation_trace.role: Consequent punishment supplies the focus act that the earlier defense sequence functionally reframes.
Equivalence supplies the limiting calibration on protective force.
Exceeding the limit distinguishes protection from the renewed aggression that triggers aid.
Pushing away harm supplies divine defense as the sequence's opening function.
Permission supplies an authorization threshold before reciprocal combat.
Combat between two parties supplies the reciprocal conflict setting without collapsing the parties' moral roles.
A wrong suffered together with a demand for redress supplies the authorization's grievance.
Vindication of the wronged directly anticipates the focus promise.
Buildings brought down supply the concrete destruction that reciprocal defense prevents.
Aid in the paired divine-human support statement supplies a cooperative rather than merely private victory mechanism.

structural_cues: 22:38-40 progresses from defense to permission to reciprocal checking and preservation of monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques.
The passive sequence يُقَاتَلُونَ/ظُلِمُوا in 22:39 anticipates عُوقِبَ/بُغِىَ in the focus.
The second aggression in 22:60 comes only after a response constrained by likeness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies authorized defense and prevention of demolition; I infer that the counterforce's telos is preservation of a shared worship ecology. Personal vindication remains a coexisting, narrower mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a private revenge rule concerned with the victim's honor.
changed_reading.after: The bounded response is protective counterforce whose wider object can be the survival of communities and their plural worship spaces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same ع ق ب root places the outcome of affairs with God before the focus, while the surah's close returns all affairs to God. Human like-for-like response is therefore an interim bounded act inside a larger adjudicative return, not possession of the final outcome.

activation_trace.role: The end and consequence of an act supply the focus response's unresolved outcome.
Equivalence supplies the narrow jurisdiction of the human act before final return.
The final consequence supplies the explicit divine ownership of where affairs end.
Affair or state supplies the full field whose outcome is not owned by either combatant.
Return and restoration supply the terminal movement of all affairs back to God.
Affairs again supply the object returned, closing the earlier outcome frame.

structural_cues: 22:41 says the outcome of affairs belongs to God after describing empowered communal practice.
22:76 says all affairs are returned to God near the surah's close.
The focus's repeated ع ق ب sits between those two statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine ownership of outcome and the return of all affairs; I infer that human equivalence is provisional rather than final judgment. The verse can still authorize an immediate response within that limit.

changed_reading.before: Equivalent retaliation itself completes justice and settles the final account.
changed_reading.after: Equivalent retaliation is a limited interim act; the consequence and final disposition remain with God, which leaves release and forgiveness structurally live.

context_deltas.mechanism: Just before the focus, an intrusive casting is removed and then the valid material is made firm, with the process becoming a test. That remove-then-secure sequence activates عفو/غفر as a two-stage model of aid: delete renewed excess and protect what remains valid.

activation_trace.role: The renewed crossing of a limit supplies the intrusive excess to be removed.
Erasure of a trace supplies the deletion half of corrective support.
Protective covering supplies the preservation half after deletion.
Casting something into a field supplies the intrusive insertion that begins the contextual sequence.
Removal followed by a replacement supplies a controlled deletion rather than indiscriminate destruction.
Making firm, exact, and secure supplies stabilization of the valid remainder.
Testing metal or person supplies the discriminating process that separates residue from what should remain.

structural_cues: 22:52 explicitly sequences casting, removal, and then confirmation.
22:53-54 assigns that process opposite revelatory effects in diseased and receptive hearts.
22:60 likewise places divine names of erasure and protection after a newly intrusive excess.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cast-remove-secure as an ordered operation; I infer an analogous arrow from renewed aggression to erasure of its residue and protection of the bounded claim. Ordinary pardon, without an editing analogy, remains live.

changed_reading.before: God supports the responder by applying a stronger counterblow to the aggressor.
changed_reading.after: Support can act like corrective editing: remove the renewed excess, preserve the valid bounded claim, and expose what the conflict reveals.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate next ayah explains divine action through night entering day and day entering night; a later image has God holding the sky from catastrophic fall in compassion. These cues recast support as governance of alternating forces plus a restraining hold when recurrence threatens collapse.

activation_trace.role: Successive phases supply the alternating positions of injury, response, and renewed injury.
Return after a like act supplies the recurrence that requires containment.
Leaving punishment supplies the possible restraining hold inside the cycle.
One thing entering another supplies the reciprocal interleaving of opposed temporal phases.
The split root's obstinate persistence image supplies the live danger that alternating response hardens into continuation.
Holding and restraining supplies the brake that prevents a regulated relation from becoming collapse.
Tender compassion supplies the motive for restraint rather than annihilation of one side.

structural_cues: 22:61 begins ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ immediately after the focus and forms a night/day, day/night chiasm.
22:65 combines motion under command with holding the sky from falling.
The focus itself alternates active and passive roles but still marks the later limit-crossing as morally asymmetric.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual temporal ingress and a compassionate restraining hold; I infer that they model management of reciprocal force without erasing the focus's moral threshold. A purely cosmic proof unrelated to conflict remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Support ends reciprocity by simply overpowering one fixed side.
changed_reading.after: Support can govern alternating phases and impose a compassionate brake when recurrence would become catastrophic, while still naming renewed excess as excess.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch of ض ع ف meaning increase by an equal amount from a surface occurrence meaning weakness. It remains anchored in the focus's مِثْل and closing erasure image, but downstream prose should present it only as a cross-root systems analogy, not as a lexical gloss of 22:60.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The response is explicitly بِمِثْلِ, while عفو can erase the trace left by that replication.

activation_trace.role: An equal counterpart supplies the replication operation whose systemic cost is tested.
Erasure of the resulting trace supplies a non-replicating way to close the harm.
A lesson-bearing example supplies the context in which likeness exposes a wider mechanism.
Increase by adding a thing's like supplies the surprising possibility that exact replication doubles total harm.
Pursuit and recovery of a right supply the legitimate claim whose method may nonetheless multiply damage.

changed_reading.before: Equivalence only reduces harm by capping retaliation.
changed_reading.after: Equivalence caps each response yet can still reproduce and double harm at system level, making erasure or release functionally significant.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This bodily reading is surprising, especially because the relapse branch belongs to the same root as the divine epithet غفور. It remains anchored in explicit focus branches for a spreading wound and recurrent lesion plus the nearby diseased-heart cue; render it as a diagnostic analogy for conflict, never as a definition of the divine name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The second بُغِىَ can activate a wound spreading beyond its boundary, while غفور carries a separate branch of a wound or illness relapsing.

activation_trace.role: A wound swelling and spreading into corruption supplies the pathology of renewed aggression after apparent closure.
A wound or illness returning after improvement supplies the relapse pattern, not a gloss of the divine epithet.
Removal of harm and clothing in safety supply the counter-movement toward recovery.
Departure from health and balance supplies a nearby diagnosis for conflict-bearing hearts.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contains two discrete legal incidents separated by ثم.
changed_reading.after: The renewed aggression can be carried as a relapse: a conflict wound that looked bounded spreads again and therefore requires healing and protection, not another superficial covering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain ecological activation built from unusual rain, growth, and tree-exudate branches. It remains anchored in four focus roots and the nearby rain-to-green-earth sequence, but should be rendered explicitly as a material analogy rather than a proposed translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ب غ ي, ن ص ر, ع ف و, and غ ف ر each expose a rain, growth, or plant-material branch inside the focus.

activation_trace.role: Rain exceeding the needed limit supplies an ecological image of force that has crossed from benefit into excess.
Rain as relief and irrigation supplies aid that restores rather than counterstrikes.
Growth and increase when something is left supplies regenerative release after restraint.
Sweet tree exudate supplies a material afterproduct that carries injury or pressure into nourishment.
Delivered water supplies the contextual input that changes the earth's state.
Fresh green vegetation supplies the visible regenerative outcome.
Smallness, subtlety, and hidden operation supply the quiet scale at which restoration occurs.

changed_reading.before: Aid answers excessive force with a larger opposing force.
changed_reading.after: Aid can be imaged as regulation of water: distinguish needed return from overflow, restrain excess, and convert the aftermath into protected regrowth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the commercial guarantee and substitute image of ع ق ب. It remains anchored in the focus's equivalence and surplus-release branches and a later right-recovery cue; present it as a possible juridical-economic model, not as the exclusive sense of عَاقَبَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ع ق ب is limited by مِثْل and closed by an عفو branch involving surplus or relinquished entitlement.

activation_trace.role: A substitute, retained exchange, or guarantee supplies a settlement model for the equivalent response.
Equivalence supplies commensurability between injury and substitute redress.
Surplus freely left or a right relinquished supplies room for settlement beyond strict collection.
Demanding and recovering a right supplies the later claim-enforcement frame.

changed_reading.before: عَاقَبَ can only denote a retaliatory blow matching an earlier blow.
changed_reading.after: The equivalent response can also be modeled as commensurate substitute redress; renewed aggression after that settlement activates guarantor-like divine vindication.

strongest_changes: The promise of support is multi-horizon and remains coherent even when the responder is killed or dies.
Bounded counterforce serves preservation of communities and worship spaces, not only private vindication.
The final outcome remains divine, making human equivalence provisional and keeping release structurally live.
عفو and غفر make support subtractive and protective as well as forceful: erase excess, preserve the valid claim, and contain recurrence.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated ع ق ب could simultaneously carry punishment, succession, recurrence, outcome, residue, and guarantee. Context changed the focus from a flat retaliation rule into coexisting models of public defense, delayed vindication, corrective removal, final return, and compassionate containment; unusual bodily, economic, and ecological branches remained live with explicit caution.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not force a choice between immediate worldly rescue and delayed or posthumous fulfillment.
It remains uncertain whether 22:61's ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ explains the whole conflict mechanism or only establishes divine capacity.
The wound, indemnity, doubling, and hydrologic models are traceable activations but may remain analogical rather than compositional readings.
The exact institutional test for publicly recognizable equivalence is not specified in the focus ayah.
